shortDescription: Abraxas Capital withdrew 5,856 Bitcoin from CEXs in the past eight hours, worth about $343 million. According to Odaily, on the 18th, the firm cleared all its on-chain holdings after losing 10.39 million USDC when its Lighter account API key was leaked.
